exposure.needed: the actual size of TLS trust bundles configured in the environment and whether they previously exceeded the PEM parsing limit

consequence.statement: Environments with TLS trust bundles that previously exceeded the PEM parsing limit can now successfully read larger trust bundles, enabling previously failing configurations to work.

assertion.statement: The pki.DecodeX509CertificateSetBytes function increases its capacity to parse PEM data, enabling support for reading larger TLS trust bundles.
